o.text:
Morphologically, from yarmaq (“to chop, cut, cleave, crack”) + -ış.
Cognates
Cognate with Karakhanid یَرِیشْ (yarïš, “contest, competition”); Turkish yarış,
Crimean Tatar yarış,
Kazakh жарыс (jarıs, “contest, competition”),
Kyrgyz жарыш (jarış, “running contest; competition”),
Southern Altai јарыш (ǰarïš, “running contest; horse race”),
Turkmen ýaryş (“contest, competition”), Tatar and
Bashkir ярыш (yarış, “contest, competition”),
Khakas чарыс (çarıs, “running contest; horse race”),
Tuvan чарыш (çarış, “running contest; competition”),
Yakut сырыс- (sïrïs-, “to race each other”).
